title: HumanSightBench: A Benchmark for Human Visual Perception in MLLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.12305v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on knowledge-intensive and reasoning-based vision-language benchmark datasets, but still struggle to solve the visual questions that people can solve easily. Evaluating the differences between MLLMs and human-level visual perception is challenging due to end-to-end evaluation which combines various skills, or because we are uncertain if individual items are valid. Specifically, observed errors may reflect visual perception, language priors, background knowledge, question ambiguity, and underspecified answers. Our guideline for HumanSightBench is that we construct items that are human-easy by construction and model-hard by evaluation. translated_title: HumanSightBench：面向多模态大语言模型中人类视觉感知能力的基准测试
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在知识密集型和基于推理的视觉-语言基准数据集上已展现出强大的性能，但仍然难以解决人类能够轻松解决的视觉问题。由于端到端评估混合了多种技能，或者因为我们不确定单个题目本身是否有效，评估MLLMs与人类水平视觉感知之间的差异具有挑战性。具体而言，观察到的错误可能反映的是视觉感知、语言先验、背景知识、问题歧义以及答案不明确等因素的综合影响。HumanSightBench的构建指导原则是：所构造的题目对人类而言“因构造而简单”，对模型而言“经评估证明困难”。HumanSightBench包含2,876道简答题型的视觉问题，涵盖7个顶级感知类别和21个子类别。我们只纳入通过五道准入门槛（问题清晰性、答案唯一性等）的题目。
tldr: 该论文提出了HumanSightBench基准，包含2,876道按“人类易、模型难”原则并通过五道准入门槛筛选的视觉问题，涵盖7个顶级感知类别和21个子类别，用于系统评估多模态大语言模型与人类视觉感知之间的差距。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces HumanSightBench, a benchmark of 2,876 visual questions that are human-easy by construction and model-hard by evaluation, spanning 7 top-level perceptual categories and 21 subcategories, to systematically measure the gap between MLLMs and human-level visual perception.
